entities.name: Kyree
entities.description: A young girl thief of the Haari tribe who must steal from Indorin's Tomb as a rite of passage and can cast a flight spell using her swords.

entities.name: Adriel
entities.description: A Serra Angel who awakens and chases Kyree after she takes the Ivory Cup.

entities.name: Haari
entities.description: A tribe of the Erg Mirab that Kyree joins as a full-fledged member.

entities.name: Indorin's Tomb
entities.description: The tomb from which Kyree must steal something valuable.

entities.name: Loot Niptil
entities.description: An amnesia-afflicted wizard, left behind after a planeswalker fight, who tricks Dreadfang into cursing himself.

entities.name: Dreadfang
entities.description: The kobold leader of the Crookshank Kobolds, who died and was enchanted with animate dead.

entities.name: Corsen Mon Duur
entities.description: A dwarf whose family is held hostage by Dreadfang.

entities.name: Peregrinator Complex
entities.description: An abandoned monastery infested with Crookshank Kobolds.

entities.name: Brass Man
entities.description: A brass construct found by a miller's son that performs impossible tasks and asks to sink into hell.

entities.name: Mita
entities.description: The only girl in a village of boys and women, who learns all the village's children are children of the Rag Man.

entities.name: Rag Man
entities.description: The father of the village children, who are fated to become Rag Men.

entities.name: Terena
entities.description: An elven princess of Ruadach who seeks Taradomnu root to cure her poisoned father.

entities.name: Beothach
entities.description: Terena's power-hungry brother who poisoned their father and is killed by his own rebounding death magic.

entities.name: Aedhan
entities.description: The elven king of Ruadach, poisoned and later assassinated by Semion.

entities.name: Grenfher
entities.description: A human boy whose family and village were killed by Beothach; Terena's lover.

entities.name: Semion
entities.description: The healer's assistant who assassinated King Aedhan.

entities.name: Commander Grinstable
entities.description: A commander ordered to take Lord Dane Isely's castle, whose siege is ended when dwarves blow up the castle.

entities.name: Glemp
entities.description: Leader of the Posied Hill dwarves who help end the siege.

entities.name: Dolena
entities.description: An aging mercenary trail guard who is healed and rejuvenated by a Basalt Monolith.

entities.name: Brons
entities.description: A trail drover who tries to kill Dolena and regresses into an embryo near the monolith.

entities.name: Dochyel
entities.description: A goblin who becomes Rundvelt's best rock sledder and improves the Goblin Rock Sled.

entities.name: Daisilodavi
entities.description: A royal assassin and actor sent by King Amjad who kills Lord Glinham and the dryad.

entities.name: Khairt
entities.description: A knight who, in Shanodin, returns to his true self as a wrestler from Oneah and a lover of beauty.

entities.name: Lord Glinham
entities.description: An enemy of King Amjad killed by Daisilodavi.

entities.name: Heart of Shanodin
entities.description: A place whose magic brings out one's true self.

entities.name: Kolli
entities.description: A fourteen-year-old girl sent to work for the fur trader Morl.

entities.name: Kalenth Ush
entities.description: A Keldon trader with a large supply of silver wolf pelts who abducts travelers.

entities.name: Wizard Tyrant
entities.description: Akkurdal, son of Anaki and Turul, who abused mana draining and created the Great Waste.

entities.name: Anaki
entities.description: An elf who drained mana from the forest to destroy water dragons and taught her technique to Turul.

entities.name: Turul
entities.description: An elf healed by Anaki who became the father of Akkurdal.

entities.name: Great Waste
entities.description: A swamp 1000 leagues wide created by Akkurdal's spellcasting.

entities.name: Telier
entities.description: An old hermit who finally understands magic by giving himself to a tree dryad.

entities.name: Sauruven Hellwald
entities.description: A Black Knight summoned in a planeswalkers' duel, who kills his friend Eumenes the minotaur.

entities.name: Eumenes
entities.description: A Hurloon Minotaur mourning his mate killed by a Stone Giant.

entities.name: Thomil
entities.description: Sauruven's planeswalker master.

entities.name: Roxanne
entities.description: A goblin helper of the wizard Malfegor who oversees the Goblin Balloon Brigade.

entities.name: Theobald
entities.description: A goblin helper of the wizard Malfegor who oversees the Goblin Balloon Brigade.

entities.name: Alzarakh
entities.description: A Dominarian planeswalker injured on Arboria who refuses to cast spells and is executed by the locals.

entities.name: Tyndryn
entities.description: A child of Arboria taught by Alzarakh to summon an Ironroot Treefolk, then killed by his pursuers.

entities.name: Arboria
entities.description: A world containing only green mana where a person cannot be attacked unless he casts a spell.

entities.name: Melelki
entities.description: A dwarf who, with daughters Tamun and Sekena, finds dragon eggs and sells them.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: A man to whom the dwarves sell dragon eggs.

entities.name: Tapestries
entities.description: A HarperPrism Magic anthology published in July 1995 and edited by Kathy Ice.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where most of the anthology's stories take place.

events.summary: Kyree takes the Ivory Cup from Indorin's sarcophagus, awakening Adriel, who chases her; Kyree escapes with an angel's feather and completes her rite.
events.quote: This feather is even more valued in the eyes of her tribe than the cup

events.summary: Loot and companions are lured to the Peregrinator Complex by Corsen on the orders of Dreadfang.
events.quote: Corsen reveals that his family is being held hostage

events.summary: Loot realizes his new name makes all the loot cursed and lets Dreadfang wield a sword, which kills him.
events.quote: Loot lets Dreadfang wield a sword from the stash, and the Crookshank leader immediately swings and stabs himself to death.

events.summary: The Brass Man does the noblewoman's impossible tasks and finally sinks her carriage into the earth; the boy marries the farmer's daughter.
events.quote: The boy and the farmer's daughter then marry for love.

events.summary: Mita learns that all the village children are children of the Rag Man and flees, becoming the first woman to be changed.
events.quote: From then on, Mita can travel everywhere see the world in dreams

events.summary: Terena uses Taradomnu herbs to make a Circle of Protection that reflects Beothach's death magic and kills him.
events.quote: making her brother's death magic rebound back onto himself, killing him.

events.summary: Terena finds her father assassinated but is pregnant, allowing her to take the throne for herself and her half-human child.
events.quote: which allows her to take the throne for herself and her half-human child according to the letter of the law.

events.summary: Posied Hill dwarves blow up Isely's castle, leaving a crater that fills with a lake blocking the valley.
events.quote: the entire castle is reduced to a huge crater that quickly fills with water

events.summary: Dolena finds a Basalt Monolith that heals her while Brons regresses into an embryo and vanishes.
events.quote: Brons gets too close to the stone, and quickly regresses past youth and childhood into a rapidly shrinking embryo and disappears.

events.summary: Dochyel becomes Rundvelt's star by getting a two-goblin rock sled made.
events.quote: Dohcyel convinces the old war hero Pashalik Mons to support the creation of an improved Goblin Rock Sled

events.summary: At the Heart of Shanodin, Daisilodavi kills Lord Glinham and the dryad; the two men nearly fight, then leave bonded.
events.quote: Daisilodavi has killed the dryad as well.

events.summary: Kolli discovers that the trader has been abducting travelers.
events.quote: this time she finds out that the trader has been abducting travelers

events.summary: Anaki and Turul's son Akkurdal abuses mana draining, creating the Great Waste and becoming the Wizard Tyrant; his granddaughter vows to kill him.
events.quote: and he is known as the Wizard Tyrant.

events.summary: Telier finally understands magic and is embraced by a dryad tree, disappearing.
events.quote: He finally understands that he has to give himself fully over to the mana to be able to use magic.

events.summary: Summoned to duel by rival planeswalkers, Sauruven kills his new friend Eumenes, sings the lament, and later kills the Stone Giant.
events.quote: the knight kills the minotaur, sings the lament for his friend, and later goes and kills the Stone Giant.

events.summary: The Goblin Balloon Brigade sets out, pulls Roxanne aloft, and crashes toward enemy troops.
events.quote: However, Roxanne gets tangled in the rope as they lift off and is pulled up into the air along with the balloon.

events.summary: Tyndryn's summoning alerts Alzarakh's pursuers, who kill her; the locals execute Alzarakh with green magic.
events.quote: From the sky a terrible attack shoots out, killing the child.

events.summary: Melelki and her daughters find dragon eggs and sell them to Reod Dai.
events.quote: find a bunch of dragon eggs and start selling them to a man called Reod Dai .
